donate.title: Help Change the World
donate.bodyP1: Changing the world is a huge goal, so we must start off the best we can. Though we currently have no live Kickstarter projects, please be on the lookout for any of our upcoming fundraising campaigns.
donate.bodyP2: By donating, you'll be able to help us support our employees, cover publishing costs, pay fees for resources like this website, trademarks, and copyright, and meet other financial necessities. We're immensely grateful of your generosity!

about.title: WE ARE GEONOVA
about.bodyP1: Founded in January of 2020, GeoNova Gaming has one goal which sets us apart from any other video game company out there. Our mission is simple: to change the world for the better. The world is constantly changing, adapting; even the way it changes, well,  changes.

artistSection1.name: Naomi Hopton
artistSection1.description: I'm a 3D modeller and digital artist. My dream is to be a tiny woodland creature in a fantasy land, but since that wish hasn't been granted yet, drawing them will do for now.

artistSection2.name: Guilherme 'Badger' Inácio
artistSection2.description: Olá, I'm a human that’s been passionate about arts & crafts since I was around 5 years old, always inspired by any soothing fantasy music. I've always loved drawing and modeling living beings, from real animals to mythical creatures.
artistSection2.favoritegame: TESV: Skyrim, Fable 2 and The Witcher 3.

artistSection3.name: Ryan Pedder
artistSection3.description: I am an artist that is enthusiastic about telling a story through the art of the game. I’ve enjoyed playing games since I was young, but never thought about how they were made until much later. Once I learnt about the process of creating games, I fell down the rabbit hole and I am still falling.

artistSection4.name: Elysia 'Ellie' Howard
artistSection4.description: Texture artist, 3D modeler, digital artist, and an avid traveler! I’ve been to Scotland, Turkey, Argentina, and even Antartica. I also have two Australian Shepherds that I love to bits!

artistSection5.name: Bao (Zumi) Cu
artistSection5.description: My passion for Pokemon since childhood prompted me to become a 3D modeler. Being able to create many different characters and their environments makes me feel like I can live in that fantasy world.
artistSection5.favoritegame: Pokemon, Genshin Impact, Honkai Star Rail.

artistSection6.name: Marlie Kohles
artistSection6.description: I've always been a crafty, artsy person that recently got into gaming in my 20s. I also love watching movies and shows with my best friend and lover.

coderSection1.name: Tam Nguyen
coderSection1.description: I’m an enthusiastic game developer/programmer who’s love for how games are made led to leading a department of like-minded individuals. I’m also a culinary master, so lemme cook… In the kitchen and in code 🔥.

coderSection2.name: Nico Gutiérrez
coderSection2.role: Mechatronic Engineer / Fullstack Web Developer / Software Developer / Computer technician

coderSection3.name: Carl Antoine
coderSection3.description: I am family-orientated and love helping out when I can. I'm a software developer and like to make games.

coderSection4.name: Nick Knight
coderSection4.description: Software engineer by day, gamer by night. If I'm not building or playing games, you can find me cheffing it up in the kitchen.

coderSection5.name: Daniel Rodriguez
coderSection5.description: Been in love with video games since the age of 3. I play fighting games competitively, mostly Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3! Best Magneto player in FL and 5th place at CEOtaku!.

coderSection6.name: India “Indō” Franklin
coderSection6.description: I'm a creative and driven person who loves building strong connections and coming up with innovative ideas to create great results for our clients and team. 'Dreams didn't make us kings. Dragons did' - Daemon Targaryen.
coderSection6.favoritegame: REV, Dead By Daylight, Animal Crossing.

coderSection7.name: Paul Howard
coderSection7.description: I started my gaming adventure on old DOS games, and never lost my love for the craft. Now, I work on coding them myself!.

coderSection8.name: Steffan Watts
coderSection8.description: My passion for games and the creative nature involved in making them began at an early age. So now being able to use my skills and take my own creative ideas and turn them into a reality so that I can share with people is really an amazing experience.
coderSection8.favoritegame: Assassin's Creed Ezio Series, Uncharted Series, Witcher 3.

coderSection9.name: Brandon Johnston
coderSection9.description: I’m an aspiring game developer from Middle Tennessee. I’m also a two time published creative fiction author.

coderSection10.name: Anthony Ferdin
coderSection10.description: I’m an aspiring game developer from Middle Tennessee. I’m also a two time published creative fiction author.

coderSection11.name: Mehki “Squint” Cannon
coderSection11.description: I’m just some dude that likes video games enough to want to make a career out of it. Don’t look too much into it.

coderSection12.name: Cameron Ghaemmaghami
coderSection12.description: Graduate from California that can solve FizzBuzz like no one else. Video games bring me great joy and anger. I program things that produce the former, but doing so produces the latter.
coderSection12.favoritegame: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, Fire Emblem.

writersSection1.name: Alunaria Verano
writersSection1.description: Hello my name is Alunaría, I am GeoNova’s Lead Writer.

writersSection2.name: Michael “Zaku” Nutt
writersSection2.description: Influenced by games at a young age, I strive to create stories that envelope the audience and leave them desolate when it's over.

writersSection3.name: Gracie “Pantaloons” Todd
writersSection3.description: I’m a director and writer specializing in all things silly and sometimes spooky. With a diverse portfolio in both live-action and animation, including a popular children’s series, a co-written horror feature currently in post-production, and ongoing work as a comedy writer for a video game. I excel in all things delightfully dumb that shows my out-of-the-box thinking and surreal style.

bardSection1.name: Michelle Lugo
bardSection1.role: Music composer / Sound Designer / Audio Implementer
bardSection1.description: I'm a music composer, sound designer, and audio implementer from Puerto Rico. I'm passionate about games and how they sound. I love creating sound for fantasy and sci-fi worlds, from feeling like you're flying to giving motivation during a battle; sound is my weapon to evoke these feelings.

bardSection2.name: David Rubenstein
bardSection2.description: I’m a retired ocean physicist, who spent a lot of time on board ships deploying instruments, and hoping to get them back. Nowadays I spend my time composing memorable music for video games, films and TV.

bardSection3.name: Rachel Williams
bardSection3.description: I'm a film and video game composer passionate about bringing stories to life through music. Outside of the studio, you can find me immersed in the world of video games!.

bardSection4.name: Joshua Brazil
bardSection4.description: Hello there! My name is Josh and I'm a composer. I started with playing guitar and piano as a kid. My passion for music, video games and film led me to pursue a career creating immersive soundtracks for interactive experiences.

marketersSection1.name: Chris Hamilton
marketersSection1.description: Hello everyone I’m Chris and I'm located in Virginia Beach, VA and have a background in social media, marketing, and brand development and awareness. I'm currently finishing up grad school and looking to get my foot in the door as a full fledged marketer!.

marketersSection2.name: Sara Gennevee Alvarez
marketersSection2.description: Hi everyone! My name is Sara and I am determined to be that one women strutting in the city with a suit and tie, high heels on, briefcase on the side, going up the mountains to my cabin next to a mini farm!.
